Commentary.Commentary: It should be a cake walk for the home side if I can call it so. South Africa have never lost a Pink ODI and with the way things have panned out, it seems like they will keep it in tact even today. How much time will they take to gun this paltry target? Let's wait and find out. Join us in a short while for the chase.

Once that happened none of the batsmen showed a stomach to fight as apart from Dickwella everyone failed to make the most of a good batting surface. South Africa will be really pleased with their efforts yet again. They gave nothing away to the visitors as the Protea bowlers were all over them. It was Pretorius who was superb with the ball picking up 3 wickets and giving away just 19 in his 7 overs. Apart from Duminy everyone has at least a wicket against their name.

Once again the Lankans have put up a dismal show with the bat. For the third time in a row they have failed to reach 200. After being put into bat, the Islanders got off to a good start as both the southpaw openers, Tharanga and Dickwella came out with a positive intent. They stringed a 60-run stand before their skipper departed.

OUT! Tahir finishes it for SA! Tossed  up wide outside off, Kumara charges down, looks to go big but gets it off the toe end straight to Rabada at mid off. Kumara like a typical tailender goes after the spinner and pays the price. SRI LANKA ARE BOWLED OUT ON 163!
Wrong one, Kumara leaves it in surprise.
Fuller and swings away late, Sandakan looks to push it away but is beaten again.
Gets it on a driving length on off, Lakshan accepts the proposal only to be beaten in the end.
Shortish in length around off, Kumara looks to pull but drags it off the inner part of the bat through square leg for a single.
Pitches it up around off, defended off the front foot.
FOUR! Swings and swings hard! Gets a length ball and dispatches it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
On a length and just outside off, Kumara offers no stroke but much to his delight the ball goes just over the stumps.
Shorter around off, punched towards covers.
Loopy outside off, spinning away, Sandakan punches it back to the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Lakshan Sandakan is the last man to walk in!

OUT! Bowled 'em! That's horrible leave to say the least. Tosses it up around off, Pathirana thought this would turn away but this one comes in and he doesn't offer any stroke. The ball goes through and disturbs the woodwork behind. Once again the Lankans won't cross the 200-run mark it seems.

Dropped but it was a tough one! Full and around off, Pathirana tries to hit this one over mid off. Couldn't get enough on it. Rabada at mid off was interested as he takes a couple of steps back and then tries to catch it with his right hand but could only get a fingertip on it. Two runs taken.
Quicker one around middle and off, it's blocked off the front foot.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
Shortish on the hips, tucked towards  backward square leg for a single.
Lahiru Kumara walks in at no. 10!

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Pretorius gets a 3-fer, his best figures in the ODIs now. Bangs in a short ball on middle, keeps climbing off the deck as Lakmal opts for the pull. He completely miscues it towards deep square leg where Farhaan Behardien settles under it and takes it with ease.
Back of a length ball on middle, pushed back to Pretorius.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Pathirana clips it deep square leg for a single.
Fuller in length and outside off, Pathirana looks to drive but gets an inside edge on the pads as the ball rolls back to the bowler.
A googly around off, coming in as Lakmal is pinged on the pads. Tahir appeals and appeals loudly but it's turned down by the umpire as it was going down leg.
On the pads, flicked through the leg side for a single.
Short and around off, Pathirana gets back and punches it towards sweeper cover. Morris in the deep does well to cut it off.
Flatter one around middle and off, Pathirana defends it down.
Short and turning away, Sachith makes room and glides it past Amla at first slip for a couple.
Tossed up around off, bunted back to the bowler.
Punched off the back foot towards the off side.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Stays back to this length delivery and shows a straight bat.
Suranga Lakmal is the new man to walk in!

OUT! Faf du Plessis, you please take a bow! It seems he has made  a habit for pulling off screamers. Saw him taking one in the Test series, then one in the previous ODI and today he does it again. Simply outstanding, he dropped one earlier but veils it up now. Good length ball outside off, Madushanka looks to guide it uppishly through to third man. However Faf at second slip is in his way, who dives full length to his right to take this one. He then throws the ball upwards and has his hands aloft. The crowd is up on its feet as well. SL slipping further.
Good length ball around off, Madushanka dabs it towards the slip cordon.
LM defends it from within the crease.

NOT OUT! Clearly a bat there! Loopy delivery around middle and leg, Pathirana gets down on one knee to sweep but it goes off something to fine leg. They all appeal and the umpire rules it out. The batsman immediately takes the review and the first replay was enough for the TV umpire to reverse the on-field decision as it went off the bat.
Sachith Pathirana is given out lbw, he has referred it upstairs straightaway.
Turns away a bit after pitching, SP leaves it alone.
Around off, turning in again and cramping Pathirana for room. He just pushes it towards the off side.
Tossed up around off, defended off the front fooy.
Outside off, turning in sharply as Sachith gets back to cut but is cramped for room and gets an inside edge as the ball rolls towards the off side.
A loopy full toss around middle and leg, pushed towards mid on.
Imran Tahir is back on.

Chance of a run out! Fuller in length and outside off, Madushanka drives it towards mid off and sets off. Pathirana sends him back as de Villiers fires in a throw at the keeper's end. de Kock fails to collect it cleanly as the throw was a bit wide from the stumps.
Good length ball on middle, defended down gently.
Madushanka shoulders arms to let that one through.
Beaten! On a length and just outside off, Madushanaka looks to poke but the ball just whizzes past the outside edge to the keeper.
The debutant, Lahiru Madushanka comes in at no. 8!

OUT! The slower one does the trick! Pretorius hurls in a slower bumper around middle and leg, it comes really slow off the deck. Dickwella looks to pull but is deceived by the lack of pace there. The ball kisses the gloves and flies back towards de Kock who dives to his left to grab it. It's also his 100th dismissal in the ODIs behind the stumps. A great knock from the opener comes to an end. South Africa continue to march on.
Fuller in length and angling in on the pads, Sachith flicks it through the leg side for a single.
Dwayne Pretorius is back for another spell.
Flattish on the pads, worked towards backward square leg for a single.
Around middle and off, pushed towards covers for one.
Advances down to this loopy ball to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Gets back and punches it down.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries, boy, this is good batting! Duminy once again drags his length short and Niroshan cuts it nicely through backward point for another boundary. It's a third consecutive one for the Lankans.
FOUR! Drops it short on middle and leg and was simply asking for trouble. Dickwella camps back and pulls it firmly behind square on the on side to earn himself another boundary.
JP Duminy is back to roll his arm over.
FOUR! That's whipped! Fuller and strayed on the pads, Pathirana gets across a touch and nails the whip shot through backward square leg for a boundary. Played it really well there.
Good length ball on middle, Pathirana defends it towards the off side with an angled bat.
Angles it away from the batsman, Pathirana opens the face of the bat and dabs it with soft hands towards du Plessis at second slip who collects it on the bounce by diving to his left.
Angled in on the hips, tucked down to fine leg for another single.
Slower in pace on the leg stump, Niroshan comes down the track and tickles it down to fine leg for another couple.

Back of a length ball on middle and leg, it rises a bit as Dickwella swivels and pulls it through backward square leg. Rabada in the deep quickly comes to his right, fumbles but does well to stop the ball. A couple added to the total.
Andile Phehlukwayo is back into the attack!
Fullish outside off, Pathirana leans and drives it through the gap in covers for a brace.
Length delivery outside off, SP looks to drive it on the up but misses.
On the pads, clipped square of the pitch on the leg side for a single.
Pitched outside off, gently pushed in covers for a single.
Full outside off, sliced to point.
Sachith Pathirana is the new man in!

OUT! Gunaratne gifts his wicket! Banged in short outside off, Gunaratne gets under it and upper cuts it straight to Pretorius at third man. That's really poor from Gunaratne as he just had to build his innings around Dickwella, who is now running out of partners. SA continuing with their regular breakthroughs! Half the side down for the visitors!
Back of a length delivery angling in, dragged to mid-wicket.
Slightly fuller angling away, defended off the front foot.
Lights are on!
On the thigh pad, flicked through backward square leg. Rabada in the deep gets to his right and cuts it out. A brace is taken!

Angling in delivery again, Asela plays it with the angle in the mid on region. Pretorius from mid on charges to the ball and hurls a throw at the bowler's end but misses but hits the batsman. A single is completed.
Wide! Wide outside off, it's too wide and the umpire spreads his arms to signal it.
Beaten for pace! Short delivery outside off, AG looks to slash it but misses.
Angling into the batsman, defended with the angle to mid-wicket.
Leg bye! Angling down leg, Gunaratne looks to clip it on its way but misses. Gets it off his boots to fine leg. Missed out on that! A leg bye taken!
Banged in short, Gunaratne leaves it.
Fullish delivery outside off, defended off the front foot to covers. Takes off for a quick single and gets it. Dickwella has been superb throughout the innings with his running between the wickets.
Angling into the batsman, defended with soft hands in the mid-wicket region for a single.
Angling down leg, Gunaratne misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. There's a stifled appeal but it's turned down as it was too high and going down leg as well.
Width on offer outside off, Niroshan guides it past point for a single.
Kagiso Rabada is back on! There are still some bees disturbing him, he shoos them away and gets ready to bowl...
Another edge! Pitched outside off, Gunaratne hangs his bat in the air, gets an outside edge. Falls just short of Faf at second slip. Nervy start for Asela after the break!
Fuller length delivery outside off, AG looks to defend it off the front foot but gets it off the outside edge into the ground to the slip cordon.
Back of a length delivery, defended off the back foot.
We are back! Finally, the interval is over. All set to go. Chris Morris will finish his pending over...
UPDATE 1410 GMT - The head groundsman has walked out in the middle with a professional, who has brought a box with himself to collect the bees and take them far from the action.

As we thought that the game was about to restart, the players have left the field. It's very frustrating out there for the players and the crowd. A solution must be found soon to get on with the play.
We are back! However, the bees are still there in certain areas. Especially where de Kock has been positioned. And so, the players are having a chat with the umpires which delays the restart further.
The bees are back! Hence, the players have been asked to leave the field. All the players have now gathered near the ropes. As there is a halt in play, drinks break has also been taken.

Slower one, angling away, pushed to covers. Faf is onto it in a flash. Dives towards the ball, picks it up and throws in one instance. Unfortunately, misses his shy and the ball goes towards deep mid-wicket. A single off the overthrow is taken. If he had hit, Asela was a goner!
Dickwella looks to be cheeky! As boundaries are drying up, Dickwella looks to go for the scoop and misses.
Length delivery angling in, Niroshan shuffles and looks to tuck it away but misses and gets it off the gloves on the off side.
Outside off, guides it off the outer half of the bat to point.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Leg spinner landed short outside off, Dickwella steps down the track, looks to turn it off the spin but misses. Gets it off the pads to cover-point for a single.
There is a slight halt in play as the bees aren't ready to leave... Seeing such instance for the first time.
Zips it in in the blockhole outside off, Niroshan kneels down and looks to sweep but misses. Even de Kock fumbles but doesn't concede a single.
Tossed up outside off, Dickwella blocks it off the front foot.
Googly outside off, ND stays back and guides it late to short third man.
Full and angling into the pads, Asela looks to play it across the line but gets squared up a touch. Gets it off the leading edge to covers.
There is a swarm of bees buzzing around at the Wanderers. All the players are down on the field.
Asela Gunaratne is the new man in!

OUT! Morris gets his man! Pitched full outside off, de Silva goes for an expansive drive. But, his feet doesn't move even a bit and he pays price for it. Gets an outside edge and the ball flies towards the slip cordon. Amla at first slip gets low to his left and takes another good catch! Just when a partnership was building up, SA strike back!
Full wide outside off, DDS pushes it to mid off.
Wide! Banged in short, de Silva pulls out of his pull as it's too high. Wide signalled for the height.
On the pads, flicked through square leg for a couple.
Length delivery outside off, de Silva defends it to point.
Back of a length delivery outside off, slapped behind point for a single.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and blocks it on the bounce.
Tossed up delivery outside of, de Silva prods forward in defence.
FOUR! Good use of the feet! De Silva gets to the pitch of the ball and whips it over mid-wicket. Hits it in the gap and finds the fence.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full delivery, driven to long on for a single.

Pitched outside off, spinning in, Niroshan gets across, kneels down for a sweep but gets rapped up on the pads. Tahir appeals once again and the appeal is once again turned down. The replays show that there was a slight under edge.
Length delivery outside off, guided through to third man for a single.
Good stop by Faf! Full and angling in, de Silva clips it beautifully through mid-wicket. Faf chases it and keeps it in just before the fence. Stops a run for his team. Three runs added!
De Silva remains composed in his defence to the incoming delivery.
Angling into the batsman, de Silva mistimes his whip in the air but gets it through the gap between mid on and mid-wicket for a brace.
Back of a length angling in, blocked off the back foot.
Angling across, ND wristily works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Chris Morris comes back into the attack!
Googly again, this time de Silva picks it and turns it to mid-wicket.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Loopy delivery, defended off the front foot.

Lbw shout turned down! Googly, spinning down leg, de Silva prods forward and fails to pick the wrong one. Gets rapped up on the pads and goes off it on the leg side. Tahir appeals confidently but is turned down. He has a chat with AB but the both decide not to go for the review.
Second ODI fifty for Dickwella!
Tossed up outside off, driven through covers for a single. Gets to his half century with it!
Full outside off, defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Well-balanced shot! Fuller and angling in, de Silva keeps his composure and times his drive through mid on to perfection. Gets a boundary for it.
Full outside off, driven through to sweeper cover for a single.
Full wide outside off, de Silva goes for a big shot. Ends up carving it on one balance to third man for a single. Gets off the mark with it!
Fullish delivery on off, angling in, holds a touch after pitching, driven off the inner half of the bat to mid on.
Pitched outside off, left alone.
Full on middle and leg, flicked through widish mid on for a single.
Wide! Banged in short, Dickwella lets it sail through. It's too high and the square leg umpire signals it as a wide.
Another back foot defence by de Silva to end the over.
Landed outside off, defended off the back foot to the bowler.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fuller on the boots, driven to mid on.
On the pads, nudged to square leg.
Spinning into the pads, worked on the leg side for a single.
Dhananjaya de Silva walks in, replacing Chandimal!

OUT! Another failure for Chandimal! Full and wide outside off, shaping further away a touch. Chandimal looses out his patience and goes after it. Ends up slicing it high in the air over cover-point. Morris in the deep places himself nicely and takes the catch. Phehlukwayo has his second of the day and leading the SA charge.
Outside off, left alone.
Very full on off, dug out to covers.

Overthrow! Unnecessary runs! Full on middle and leg, clipped through mid-wicket. AB runs to his left and stops the ball. Hurls a throw at the striker's end. It's not a necessary one as the batsman hasn't even left his crease. Hits the woodwork and the ball ricochets towards covers. A single is taken off the overthrow!
Full and angling away, driven off the inner half of the bat to mid on.
Banged in short, angling away, Niroshan pulls it into the ground to mid-wicket.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Dickwella charges down and takes it on the full. Pushes it through mid off for a single.
The batsman has driven it back to the bowler.
Tossed up delivery outside off, DC leans ahead and drives it through mid off for a single.
Dickwella turns it with the spin through mid-wicket for a single.
Spinning away, guided with the turn past first slip for a single.
Full delivery, driven straight back to the bowler.
Back of a length delivery, rises a touch onto Chandimal, he stays back and gently defends it to short leg. Takes a quick single. Good running there!

Lbw shout turned down! Length delivery angling in, Chandimal shuffles and walks ahead to flick but misses. Gets rapped up on the front pad and there is a loud shout. However, it's turned down as Chandimal was long way across and also height might be the issue.
Wide outside off, Chandimal looks to make the use of the width but misses his slash.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length delivery outside off, dragged on the leg side for a single.
Driven straight back to Tahir, he dives to his right and stops it.
In the blockhole outside off, blocked on the off side.
Loopy delivery in the line of the stumps, driven through mid on for a single.
Googly, spinning into the pads, Chandimal nudges it through mid-wicket for a single.
Straighter one outside off, defended on the off side by proding forward.
Full outside off, turned through square leg for a single.
Imran Tahir is on now!
Dinesh Chandimal is the new man in!

OUT! Edged and gone! Phehlukwayo strikes in his very first over! Serves a length ball around off, it holds its line, Mendis pokes at it. Gets a thick outside edge towards first slip where Amla dives to his left to hold on to a superb catch. Mendis departs without troubling the scorers much.
Wide! Bangs in another shortish ball, it goes well over the batsman.
Shortish outside off, Mendis ducks under it.
Fuller in length on the stumps, Mendis covers the line and drives it firmly past mid on for two.
On the pads, clipped to deep square leg for another single.
Angles it on the pads, flicked through square leg for a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, glided down to third man for a single.
Andile Phehlukwayo is introduced into the attack!
Gets deep in the crease and defends it towards mid-wicket for a brisk single. 9 off the over!
Fuller on off, pushed towards covers for nothing.
Good length ball on off, Niroshan looks to poke but gets beaten.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! This time Rabada offers a little bit of width outside off and it's enough for Dickwella to cash in. He flays it through point for a boundary.

FOUR! Rubbish delivery from Rabada and duly punished! Sprays it down the leg side, Niroshan gets inside the line and tickles it fine down the leg side. Pretorius in the deep puts in a desperate dive but fails to stop it from crossing the rope.
Floats it up around middle, worked through the leg side for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Dickwella gets across and paddle sweeps it towards fine leg for a couple. Had he misses, he would have been dead plumb.
On middle and leg, milked down to long on for a single.
Pushes it slower through the air around off, Kusal defends it off the front foot.
Tossed up around off, defended down by Mendis.
Kusal Mendis walks in at no.3!

OUT! Got him... Rabada draws first blood this time! Shortish around off, Tharanga stays put as he goes for the pull. He gets a big top edge which flies towards fine leg. Pretorius at fine leg comes running in a bit and takes a safe catch. Duminy will be relieved at the moment as the Lankan skipper walks back.

Dropped! JP Duminy the culprit! Fuller in length and angling in, Dickwella walks across the sticks to flick but gets a leading edge. The ball squirts over point as Duminy backpedals from there. Gets underneath the ball but makes a meal out of it. You don't see him dropping those. A single taken.
Very full around off, driven firmly to mid off for a single.
Good length length ball around off, Tharanga looks to tuck but gets an inside edge on the pads and the ball dies down near the stumps.
AB de Villiers is shaking that left wrist of his. Still looks to be in little bit of pain!
Short of a length ball outside off, Upul initially goes for the pull but the ball rises a bit more and he withdraws his bat at the last moment.
Angles it on the pads, Niroshan tucks it fine down the leg side for a single.
On the pads, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Drops it short and outside off, Tharanga punches it behind point and sets off. There is a fumble in the deep and they pick up another run.
Tossed up outside off, UT drives it off the front foot but finds the man at short extra cover.
Angles it in around middle and leg, Upul lunges forward and defends it towards the leg side.
Loopy ball around middle, turning away a bit, Tharanga defends it down.
Floats it up around off, Dickwella comes down the track and drives it through covers for a single.
Also, JP Duminy comes into the attack!
Powerplay 2 signalled! Maximum 4 fielders allowed outside the circle now.
Wide outside off, UT covers his stumps and shoulders his arms.
Angling into the stumps, defended in front of square on the leg side.
Full outside off, sliced to point.
FOUR! Beautiful shot that! Full outside off, times his drive through mid off to perfection. Gets it past diving de Villiers there and earns himself a boundary.
Play and a miss! Tharanga gets carried away with the earlier shot. Looks to drive the outside off delivery but ends up swinging in the air.

Not a good sign for SA! Their skipper his hurt! Fullish delivery around off, UT drives it straight down the ground. De Villiers from mid off gives it a chase, puts it a dive but gets his hand stuck in the turf. Tahir from mid on then completes the chase and keeps it down to two. De Villiers seems to have hurt his left wrist on that attempt but is okay to carry on!
Kagiso Rabada is back on!
Shortish around off, Dickwella stays back and punches it towards the man at covers.

Good length ball around off, it straightens a bit after pitching, Tharanga gets squared up as he looks to defend. The ball goes off the outer part of the bat towards third man and they cross for a single.
Upul has driven it straight down the ground.
Gets back and punches it through covers for a single.
Good length ball, angling in, ND looks to tuck but misses as the ball hits the thigh pad and lobs towards covers.
Two man behind square in the deep now. A deep square leg and a fine leg.
FOUR! Easily done again! Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Dickwella whips it over backward square leg for a one bounce boundary.
Fuller in length and outside off, UT forces it straight to cover.
Beaten! Fuller in length and moves away further after pitching, Tharanga goes for the drive but is beaten by the away swing there.
Fuller in length and just around off, pushed straight to mid off.
Upul gets up on his toes to play that one.
Hits the deck hard on middle, Tharanga ducks under it.
FOUR! Upul has pulled it away! Gets a short ball which he was waiting for, swivels a bit and nails the in front of square to earn a boundary. A good way to start the over.
No run.
Stays back and defends it down gently.
Just over the stumps! A slower one around middle and leg, Dickwella gets down and across to scoop but misses as the ball just bounces over the timber and goes towards de Kock.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Shortish and down the leg side, all Tharanga had to do was the get some bat on it and he does so with ease. The ball races down to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Good length ball on off, Tharanga comes forward and keeps it out.
Played to the point region by the batsman.

Leading edge... safe! Both the batsmen have some luck by their side! Fuller in length and angling in, Dickwella closes the face of the bat early and gets a leading edge towards Tahir at mid on. The leggie tries his best to reach towards the ball but it falls just short of him. Another chance goes down begging.

Edged and it's spilled! Morris has his hands on his head! Bowls a very full outside off, Tharanga reaches out to that one and gets a thick outside edge which flies towards the slip cordon. Du Plessis at second slip leaps to take it with his right hand but the ball doesn't stick and goes off the palms. A single taken, Tharanga gets a reprieve.
Wide! Hurls a full ball on off, it's swings away further, Tharanga leaves it alone.
Leg bye! Good length ball on the pads, Niroshan misses his flick as the ball goes off the pads towards fine leg and they take a leg bye.
Drives this full ball towards the man at mid off.

FOUR! Good shot! Back of a length ball outside off, Dickwella rises on the toes, keeps the bat face upwards, arches a bit and guides it down to third man. Rabada comes across to his left, puts in a dive but the ball still wins the race.
Maiden over from Pretorius! Good length delivery, shapes in a touch, it's defended down solidly.
Fuller in length and around off, Upul looks to drive but gets it off the inner part of the bat back to Pretorius.
Good length ball in the line of the stumps, it's defended with a straight bat down the wicket.
Tharanga has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Comes in with the angles and cramps Tharanga for room who manages to tuck it away on the leg side.
Starts with a length ball on middle, UT stands in his crease to defend it.
Dwaine Pretorius replaces Rabada.
Upul digs out the very full delivery towards mid off for a single to keep strike.
Brave leave! On a length and nipping back in from outside off, Tharanga presses forward and then lifts his bat to let it go. The ball just about kisses the off pole.
Fuller in length and angling in, pushed towards mid off for a single. There is a shy at the striker's end but misses.
A length ball outside off, Niroshan looks to cut it away but slices it over the point fielder and comes back for a double.
Good length ball on off, Dickwella defends it back to the bowler.
ND defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Back of a length ball on middle, comes at a nice height too. Tharanga swivels a touch and pulls it through backward square leg for another boundary. End of an eventful over!
A stifled appeal for an LBW! This one nips back in again and catches Tharanga on the front pad. The height seemed to be an issue there.
FOUR! Classical drive! Slightly overpitched around off, Tharanga lunges forward and creams it off the meat of the bat past covers to find the fence. Beautifully done!
Angles it in from around middle, UT comes forward to play at it but misses and once again is hit on the pads.
Short of a length ball on middle, Tharanga ducks under it.

A loud shout for lbw! On a length and coming in a bit at 140.2 kph, Tharanga misses his flick and is rapped on the pads. They all go up in an appeal but umpire Kettleborough shakes his head. Rabada and de Villers think about reviewing it but then go against it. Replays show it was pitched outside leg.

FOUR! Top edge! Bangs in a short ball on middle and leg, it keeps climbing as Dickwella looks to pull. The ball catches the top part of his willow and flies down to the fine leg fence for a boundary to end the over.
Uppishly played! Fuller and angling it in, ND gets across and lofts it over wide mid on for a brace.
Beauty! On a length and gets some bounce off the deck, Dickwella rises on the toes to defend but is beaten all ends up.
Gets this one to nip in a bit, Dickwella works it towards square leg for nothing.
Back of a length ball on off, Upul places it behind point for one.

Leading edge... safe! Morris starts with a slightly short of a full length delivery, nipping in a bit, Dickwella looks to flick it on the leg side but gets a leading edge. It balloons high in the air but falls safely near mid off. A single taken.
Chris Morris to bowl from the other end.
Good length ball, angling in, tucked towards the leg side for nothing.
Touch fuller and angling in, Dickwella drives it towards the left of mid on for a single.
Nicely done! Hurls it on the pads, it's clipped through backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Wide! Slips it down the leg side, Niroshan looks to flick but fails to get any bat on it.
Edged and away! On a length and just outside off, Upul comes forward to defend but gets it off the outer part of the bat towards third man for a single to get off the mark.
Angles it in from around middle, Tharaga prods a bit and defends it down.
Starts with a back of a length ball on the hips, Dickwella just uses the pace and clips it down to long leg for a single. SL are underway.

We are all set to get underway. The players and umpires have made their way out to the middle. The Wanderers crowd is out in numbers. It's the famous Pink ODI for the cause of breast cancer. Out come the Lankan openers - Niroshan Dickwella and Upul Tharanga. South Africa start with Kagiso Rabada who has a couple of slips in place. Here we go!!!

Team changes - Dwaine Pretorius and Farhaan Behardien replace Wayne Parnell and David Miller for SA. While, Chaturanga de Silva and Nuwan Kulasekara make their way out for the visitors. Two Lahirus, Madushanka and Kumara to make their ODI debuts.
Toss - South Africa win the toss and opt to field!

Sri Lanka on the other hand have been anything but dismal. They haven't even reached the 200-run mark in the first two ODIs. Time is running out for them as they will have to turn it around in this match as if they don't, they will lose the series. To add to their woes, it's the 'Pink ODI', which the hosts have never lost. However, it's the perfect occasion for the Lankans to rise as it's their 69th Independence Day!

Hello and a warm welcome to the third ODI between South Africa and Sri Lanka. After losing to the Islanders in the T20I series, the Proteas have come back strongly by handing the visitors some heavy defeats in the last two games. They played some of their best cricket with each and every player contributing to the win. They will look to continue their form and clinch the series today itself.
